g.text: BC-05 Inventory Availability — Logical Database Design
usable_on_hand_quantity is reconciled from immutable movement records.
Reservation is the sole demand subtraction; backing only distributes it.
PK = primary key | FK = local foreign key | required = NOT NULL.
Commitment, fulfillment and SKU columns are typed references to other contexts.
Allocation, backing and reservation retain separate root identities.
